title: Sound Devices in Literature — Alliteration, Onomatopoeia, Rhyme, Assonance, and Consonance
skills: identify common sound devices in poetry and prose
distinguish alliteration, assonance, consonance, rhyme, and onomatopoeia
analyze how sound devices create rhythm, emphasis, and mood
support interpretations of sound effects with textual evidence
alignment_note: Introduces major sound devices used in literature, including alliteration, onomatopoeia, rhyme, assonance, and consonance. Supports poetry analysis, sound-pattern recognition, interpretation of rhythm and mood, and analysis of author's craft across high school English courses.
